saw_lines: K-Pop fans buy an album, then chase the photocard and light stick to complete the set.
So the sale is won or lost in the ad itself, when a fan decides whether this release is worth buying.
Your 3 of 9 copy ads repeat one exact copy, so change the opening line and creative in each and lead with the 120€ free shipping.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 28 Oct 2026
points: One exact copy runs in 3 of 9 ads, so the same pitch repeats to the same fans. Keep the body copy, but change the opening line and creative in each, leading with the 120€ free shipping from your site.

None of your 19 ads carries a proof number, so new K-Pop buyers have no reason to trust a shop they do not know. Collect one real figure, like review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it.

3 of your 9 copy ads open on the same line, “Europe’s #1 K-Pop Store”, so the copy reads as one claim. Test two new openers against it, one leading with the 120€ free shipping and one with a shipping question.
10 of your 19 live ads are catalog feed ads with no story, so the feed gives buyers no reason to stop. Shoot 3 short story ads of albums being opened and run them beside the feed.

ads_1: Album unboxing story ads opening with the 120€ free shipping offer
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Twitter
